integrity: The finite-domain assertion follows from an exhaustive exact polynomial-image recursion with a standalone checker; the infinite-family assertion follows from a direct coefficient inequality. Independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one distinct polynomial at order 16, not an assertion of a unique graph isomorphism type.
The exhaustive finite certificate treats all trivially perfect graphs only up to order 16; larger orders are addressed only for the specified three-blade family.
The generalized friendship-graph domination formula is prior work and is credited.
An unindexed earlier exact cutoff under quasi-threshold or rooted-forest terminology cannot be ruled out by search.
title: Sharp 16-vertex onset of domination-polynomial non-log-concavity in trivially perfect graphs
